proposals.premise: The step-free alternate reaches the far side. Put route choice first so visitors can see what they can reach before they start walking.
proposals.opening: Desktop pairs a three-stop list with a licensed photo. Phone puts two thumb-sized route buttons above the next-stop card, with a preview button when available.
proposals.move: Tap Step-free route. The card shows the next reachable stop and keeps the choir’s 20:30 finish visible. The bridge sample is labeled 46 seconds and can play away from the narrow path.
proposals.tradeoff: Route choice is immediate, while the choir deadline shares attention with the other stops.

proposals.premise: Visitors may expect to hear all three sounds in order. The choir ends at 20:30, so let that deadline shape the route choice.
proposals.opening: Desktop places the choir deadline and route choices beside a licensed photo. Phone pairs the deadline with two thumb-sized choices, Include choir and Bell and bridge.
proposals.move: Tap Include choir. The panel opens the step-free route and shows its next reachable stop beneath the 20:30 deadline. Bell and bridge previews sit below the route, with bridge playback available away from the narrow path.
proposals.tradeoff: Visitors see the deadline before committing, while previews take an extra scroll on phones.
